levels.surface: أبو الحسن علي بن خالد المراغي
أبو عبد الله جعفر بن عبد الله العلوي المحمدي

notes: «بت ليلة عند أمير المؤمنين علي بن أبي طالب» : Ali speaks inside Nawf's narrated encounter, and the report names him only in the words after the chain. He is not added; whether he is source or only in the scene is a ruling (rule 11, rule 6).
RWY splits this into two routes; the text carries one continuous chain («قال: حدثنا يحيى بن هاشم» follows Abu Ja'far's line), so one group is written.
The «1 -» prefix is the report number.
